summary: Iteration 20 · Frontend-only verification of Master+Preview auto-upgrade transition fix in v2.html (pollAutoUpgrade). All 4 test areas PASS: (1) MAIN BUG — with MASTER license and caja.plan.preview.v1='STD', after seeding a PREMIUM license in Mongo for the same install_id and calling window.checkPlanUpgradeNow(), the preview flag flipped from STD→PRM, body[data-not-premium] flipped 1→0, window.isPremiumLicense() returned true, banner text updated from '💼 Vista prèvia: STANDARD (Premium bloquejat)' to '⭐ Vista prèvia: PREMIUM', a toast '🎉 ¡Plan actualizado a PREMIUM automáticamente! (Vista previa MASTER: …Tu clave MASTER sigue intacta.)' appeared, AND critically the caja.license.v1 was UNCHANGED (type still 'MASTER', key still MB-MASTER-BRUGULAT-2026-OWNER). (2) SUB-TEST — exit-preview-btn onclick 'localStorage.removeItem(caja.plan.preview.v1); location.reload()' verified: preview removed, banner hidden, Master mode fully restored (isPremium=true, data-not-premium='0'). (3) REGRESSION 1 — non-master JWT/STD user with stub JWT correctly received the FULL upgrade: caja.license.v1 replaced with type='JWT', plan='PREMIUM', key=real JWT (eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9....STzg3LF1wRgc_oRrUx6cBwU6ZZeuIo-9JvSzP6OnW4w) — no caja.plan.preview.v1 flag set. (4) REGRESSION 2 — MASTER without preview: instrumented window.fetch confirmed ZERO calls to /api/licenses/current, license unchanged, no upgrade toast injected. The `if(isMaster && !preview) return;` early-exit at v2.html:7029 works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix VERIFIED (v2.html lines 7023-7103 pollAutoUpgrade): Correctly distinguishes 3 cases: (a) Master WITHOUT preview → early-return; (b) Master WITH preview → update ONLY caja.plan.preview.v1 (STD/PRM/TRIAL mapping), refresh UI, update banner label, show informative toast — Master JWT license key is NEVER overwritten; (c) Non-master → full JWT swap with real premium key. All three paths tested end-to-end.

Banner update path VERIFIED (v2.html lines 7085-7097): The dynamic banner label update inside pollAutoUpgrade correctly finds #planPreviewLabel + #planPreviewBanner and applies the labelMap → confirmed live update from 'STANDARD (Premium bloquejat)' to '⭐ Vista prèvia: PREMIUM'. Also sets banner.style.display='block' as a defensive measure (was already visible via IIFE at line 236-249 that runs on page load).

isPremiumLicense (v2.html:5081-5102) VERIFIED: Master-with-preview STD → returns false (Premium blocked); Master-with-preview PRM → returns true; Master-no-preview → returns true; JWT/plan=PREMIUM → returns true. Behavior consistent across all 4 test scenarios.

planRank ordering (line 7009 PLAN_RANK) prevents downgrade: PREMIUM=3 > STD=2 > TRIAL=1. planRank(remotePlan) < planRank(localPlan) early-returns at line 7070 protecting against accidental downgrades from webhook race conditions. Not directly tested but reviewed and sound.

No side-effects on non-preview Master flow: fetch instrumentation shows 0 calls to /api/licenses/current when Master user has no preview flag — matches the expected `if(isMaster && !preview) return;` (line 7029).

Playwright note: the exit-preview-btn is behind the 'Configuración inicial' modal for fresh installs; test its onclick by executing the inline handler directly via JS (`document.querySelector('[data-testid="exit-preview-btn"]').onclick()`) rather than page.click.
rca of the issue: Root cause: pollAutoUpgrade in v2.html previously exited for ANY Master user (`if(isMaster) return`), so the Master owner could never see the Standard→Premium transition when testing via Vista Prèvia mode. Fix in this iteration (lines 7027-7029 + 7076-7103): poll now runs for Master ONLY when caja.plan.preview.v1 is set; and instead of overwriting the Master JWT (which would break Owner access), it updates ONLY the preview flag (STD/PRM/TRIAL) plus banner label/display and shows a toast — perfectly simulating what a real client sees on plan transition. This preserves the Master key for the owner while making Vista Prèvia truly faithful to real-client behavior.
